messages.subject: Milkweed Bomb Issue
messages.text:
I ordered the milkweed bombs & planted them early July & they’ve never come up. I ordered 3 different kinds along w/ a native flower bomb. I followed the instructions but nothing is happening. I’d like to either get a replacement w/ seeds this time or a refund as I don’t believe I was sent viable seeds/bombs. Most everyone I’ve talked to who does milkweed said they’ve never heard of anyone being sent seed bombs before, only seeds they plant. Please respond & let me know What can be done. I’ve attached a copy of my order also. Thanks 

 Sheryl

messages.subject: Re: Milkweed Bomb Issue
messages.text:
Hello Sheryl,
 

 Thank you for your message.
 

 We are sorry to hear that the seed bombs did not germinate. This can happen sometimes, as nature can be capricious and milkweed requires certain conditions to grow well. We have many customers whose milkweed bombs have grown successfully.
 

 Did you plant your milkweed bombs in a place where there is no competition with other plants and where it is well-drained? Did you plant them in a place where there is significant sunlight?
 

 Concerned about the satisfaction of our customers, we propose to reship the bombs originally ordered in spring 2026. Indeed, the season is too advanced to plant the bombs now, so it would be better to do it next spring.
 

 If this solution does not satisfy you, we will refund your order.
 

 We are waiting to hear from you!
 

 Warmly,
 __
 Véronique 
 Customer Service 
 Lasclay

messages.subject: Re: Milkweed Bomb Issue
messages.text:
Hi Sheryl,
 

 We have received your message and are doing our utmost to respond and assist you as quickly as possible. It's a busy time for messages, and our customer service team is still quite small: just 1 full-time person and me, who helps out occasionally amidst my dozens of other tasks!
 

 Rest assured, however, that your situation will not be overlooked, and we will take care of it as soon as possible. It is understood that the return period applies from the time the customer notifies us of a desire to make an exchange or a refund, not from when we have time to respond. Serving our customers well is a high priority for us, even if we are sometimes a bit overwhelmed.
 

 In short, we haven't forgotten about you and we're working hard to not let you down!
